findings.body: The compiled ERB contains a stray `if` after `end`, so the template fails to compile (SyntaxError) and every embed page render returns a 500 instead of the discussion highlights.
findings.failure_mode: Template compilation error at render time, producing a server error for all embed requests.
findings.impact: The compiled ERB contains a stray `if` after `end`, so the template fails to compile (SyntaxError) and every embed page render returns a 500 instead of the discussion highlights.
findings.root_cause: A trailing `if` keyword was left in the block-closing ERB tag when the header conditional was written.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the tag to `<%- end %>` so the `if/else` block from lines 2-5 is closed correctly.
findings.title: Invalid ERB tag `<%- end if %>` breaks the embed template
findings.trigger: Any request to GET /embed/best that resolves to an existing topic and renders app/views/embed/best.html.erb.
findings.verifier_reason: Line 6 verbatim shows `<%- end if %>` which is invalid ERB syntax. The `if` after `end` is a syntax error that will cause template compilation to fail, breaking all embed page renders.

raw_findings.body: The feed's HTML is stored verbatim in posts.cooked and later emitted through `<%= raw post.cooked %>` and the normal topic view, allowing stored XSS/arbitrary markup injection from the remote feed.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Untrusted markup is persisted as trusted cooked HTML and rendered to all viewers.
raw_findings.impact: The feed's HTML is stored verbatim in posts.cooked and later emitted through `<%= raw post.cooked %>` and the normal topic view, allowing stored XSS/arbitrary markup injection from the remote feed.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new raw_html branch bypasses the entire cooking/sanitizing pipeline for content that originates from untrusted remote sources.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Run raw_html content through the existing sanitizer (e.g. PrettyText/Sanitize with a whitelist) before returning it from `cook`, instead of returning `raw` unfiltered.
raw_findings.title: raw_html cook method stores unsanitized third-party HTML as cooked content
raw_findings.trigger: SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled with a feed whose item content contains `<script>` or event-handler attributes; Jobs::PollFeed calls TopicEmbed.import which creates the post with cook_method raw_html.

raw_findings.body: NoMethodError on nil is raised inside the hourly job; because `sidekiq_options retry: false`, the whole polling run aborts and no items from that feed are ever imported.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Unhandled exception aborts the scheduled feed import job.
raw_findings.impact: NoMethodError on nil is raised inside the hourly job; because `sidekiq_options retry: false`, the whole polling run aborts and no items from that feed are ever imported.
raw_findings.root_cause: The importer assumes every feed item exposes a `content` attribute rather than handling the common RSS description-only case.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Fall back to `i.description` when `i.content` is blank and skip the item when both are missing, e.g. `content = i.content || i.description; next if content.blank?`.
raw_findings.title: PollFeed dereferences i.content which is nil for feeds without a content element
raw_findings.trigger: A configured RSS 2.0 feed whose items only provide `<description>` (no `content:encoded`), so SimpleRSS returns nil for `item.content`.

raw_findings.body: Bundler aborts with "The Gemfile has changed / gems are missing from the lock", breaking CI and deployments; at runtime `require 'ruby-readability'` / `require 'simple-rss'` raise LoadError if the gems are not installed.
raw_findings.evidence:
gem 'ruby-readability', require: false
gem 'simple-rss', require: false
raw_findings.failure_mode: Frozen bundle resolution fails, so builds and deploys cannot install dependencies.
raw_findings.impact: Bundler aborts with "The Gemfile has changed / gems are missing from the lock", breaking CI and deployments; at runtime `require 'ruby-readability'` / `require 'simple-rss'` raise LoadError if the gems are not installed.
raw_findings.root_cause: Dependency declarations were added without regenerating the lockfile that the repository ships.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Run bundler and commit the updated Gemfile.lock (and Gemfile_rails4.lock) containing ruby-readability and simple-rss.
raw_findings.title: New runtime gems added to Gemfile without corresponding Gemfile.lock entries
raw_findings.trigger: Running `bundle install --deployment`/`bundle check` (CI, production deploy) with the committed Gemfile.lock, which this patch does not update.

raw_findings.body: On re-run the existing top_topics table is dropped and all computed top-topic data is lost silently; existing installs also diverge from the new file since the migration will not re-execute.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Data loss / schema divergence between installs depending on migration history.

raw_findings.root_cause: A previously released migration was mutated to add a destructive `force: true` option instead of adding a new migration.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Revert this line to `create_table :top_topics do |t|`; if a table conflict must be handled, do it in a new migration rather than mutating a shipped one.
raw_findings.title: Already-applied migration edited to add destructive `force: true`
raw_findings.trigger: Any environment where 20131223171005 was already run (the edit is invisible there) or where the migration is re-run/rolled forward on a database that already has top_topics rows.

raw_findings.body: Messages from a non-Discourse origin are accepted and can resize the embed iframe arbitrarily (e.g. to 0 or a huge height), hiding or disrupting the hosting page.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Origin validation can be bypassed by a prefix-matching attacker origin.
raw_findings.impact: Messages from a non-Discourse origin are accepted and can resize the embed iframe arbitrarily (e.g. to 0 or a huge height), hiding or disrupting the hosting page.
raw_findings.root_cause: The sender validation uses `indexOf` substring containment rather than an equality check against the expected origin.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Compare exactly, e.g. derive the Discourse origin once and use `if (e.origin !== discourseOrigin) { return; }`.
raw_findings.title: postMessage origin check uses substring matching instead of exact origin comparison
raw_findings.trigger: A message posted from any window whose origin string is a substring of discourseUrl, e.g. discourseUrl "http://discuss.example.com/" and an attacker-controlled frame/popup at "http://discuss.example.co".

raw_findings.body: `document.getElementById` returns null and `comments.appendChild` throws a TypeError, aborting the script so no iframe and no resize listener are installed, with only a console error to diagnose it.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Uncaught TypeError silently disables the whole embed on misconfigured host pages.
raw_findings.impact: `document.getElementById` returns null and `comments.appendChild` throws a TypeError, aborting the script so no iframe and no resize listener are installed, with only a console error to diagnose it.
raw_findings.root_cause: The embed bootstrap assumes the target container is always present at script execution time.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Guard the insertion, e.g. `if (!comments) { return; }` (or log a clear message) before creating and appending the iframe.
raw_findings.title: embed.js dereferences the comments container without checking it exists
raw_findings.trigger: The host page loads embed.js before the `#discourse-comments` element exists in the DOM, or the element id is mistyped/absent.

raw_findings.body: The iframe src becomes "http://discuss.example.comembed/best?...", the request fails to resolve and the embed renders empty.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Malformed iframe URL yields a broken embed with no diagnostics.
raw_findings.impact: The iframe src becomes "http://discuss.example.comembed/best?...", the request fails to resolve and the embed renders empty.
raw_findings.root_cause: String concatenation of a configurable base URL without normalizing the trailing separator.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Normalize the base URL before concatenation, e.g. `var base = discourseUrl.replace(/\/?$/, '/');` and build the src from `base`.
raw_findings.title: Embed iframe URL concatenation assumes discourseUrl ends with a slash
raw_findings.trigger: A host page defines `discourseUrl = "http://discuss.example.com"` (no trailing slash), which is the natural way to write a site URL.

raw_findings.body: The `retrieved:<url>` key persists forever, so `retrieved_recently?` always returns true and that page's topic is never retrieved again for non-staff visitors.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Permanently stuck throttle key blocks future retrievals for the affected URL.
raw_findings.impact: The `retrieved:<url>` key persists forever, so `retrieved_recently?` always returns true and that page's topic is never retrieved again for non-staff visitors.
raw_findings.root_cause: The throttle lock is created in two non-atomic Redis commands.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Set value and TTL atomically, e.g. `$redis.set(retrieved_key, "1", nx: true, ex: 60)`, and treat the return value as the lock result.
raw_findings.title: Redis throttle key can be left without a TTL
raw_findings.trigger: The worker process dies, or the Redis connection drops, between the SETNX and the EXPIRE call for a given embed_url.

raw_findings.body: All imported topics are stamped with the current time instead of the original Disqus thread date, so imported archives appear as brand-new topics and sort incorrectly.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Silent metadata loss during migration with no error surfaced to the operator.
raw_findings.impact: All imported topics are stamped with the current time instead of the original Disqus thread date, so imported archives appear as brand-new topics and sort incorrectly.
raw_findings.root_cause: The rewrite to TopicEmbed.import_remote dropped the created_at option that the previous PostCreator invocation supplied.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Extend `TopicEmbed.import_remote`/`import` to accept and forward a `created_at` option and pass `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])` here, as the removed PostCreator call did.
raw_findings.title: Disqus import no longer preserves the original thread creation date
raw_findings.trigger: Running `thor disqus:import` on an export whose threads carry `created_at` values (previously passed to PostCreator).

raw_findings.body: Those links/images are left untouched and resolve against the Discourse host, producing broken links and missing images in the imported post, contradicting the method comment "Convert any relative URLs to absolute".
raw_findings.failure_mode: Imported content renders broken links/images while the code comment implies full coverage.
raw_findings.impact: Those links/images are left untouched and resolve against the Discourse host, producing broken links and missing images in the imported post, contradicting the method comment "Convert any relative URLs to absolute".
raw_findings.root_cause: The rewrite logic tests only for a leading slash rather than resolving all relative references against the source URL.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Resolve every non-absolute href/src with `URI.join(url, value).to_s` (rescuing invalid URIs) instead of only handling values that start with '/'.
raw_findings.title: absolutize_urls only rewrites root-relative URLs despite claiming to handle relative URLs
raw_findings.trigger: An imported feed/article whose markup uses document-relative links such as `` or ``.

raw_findings.impact: A misleading dependency is loaded on every job load, implying the job sends email and adding needless coupling for maintainers.

raw_findings.title: Unused require of 'email/sender' in the RetrieveTopic job

raw_findings.body: Unused public method (and the `digest/sha1` require it motivates) suggests a conditional-GET caching feature that does not exist, misleading future maintainers.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Dead code implies behavior the job does not have.
raw_findings.impact: Unused public method (and the `digest/sha1` require it motivates) suggests a conditional-GET caching feature that does not exist, misleading future maintainers.
raw_findings.root_cause: Half-implemented caching helper committed without any call site.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Either remove `feed_key` or actually use it to store/compare the feed's Last-Modified value before parsing.
raw_findings.title: Dead `feed_key` method in PollFeed

raw_findings.body: Regressions in feed parsing — such as the nil `i.content` crash for description-only RSS — ship undetected because no test loads a feed fixture.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Untested import path allows runtime failures to reach production.
raw_findings.impact: Regressions in feed parsing — such as the nil `i.content` crash for description-only RSS — ship undetected because no test loads a feed fixture.
raw_findings.root_cause: Tests were written only for the guard clauses in `execute`, leaving the job's real work uncovered.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Add an example that stubs `open` with an RSS/Atom fixture and asserts TopicEmbed.import is called with the expected url/title/content, including a description-only item.
raw_findings.title: PollFeed spec never exercises poll_feed's parsing/import logic

raw_findings.body: The example never verifies the missing-parameter behavior it names (and the name claims 404 while the code path yields 403), so removing `params.require(:embed_url)` would not fail the suite.

    response.should_not be_success
raw_findings.failure_mode: False-positive coverage of the required-parameter check.
raw_findings.impact: The example never verifies the missing-parameter behavior it names (and the name claims 404 while the code path yields 403), so removing `params.require(:embed_url)` would not fail the suite.
raw_findings.root_cause: The test asserts only a generic non-success response without isolating the parameter-validation path.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Stub `SiteSetting.embeddable_host` and the referer so the filter passes, then assert `ActionController::ParameterMissing` is raised (and rename the example to match the real status).
raw_findings.title: Embed controller spec's missing-embed_url example passes for the wrong reason
raw_findings.trigger: `SiteSetting.embeddable_host` defaults to '' in the test environment, so `ensure_embeddable` raises InvalidAccess (403) before `params.require(:embed_url)` is ever reached.

finding.body: Messages from a non-Discourse origin are accepted and can resize the embed iframe arbitrarily (e.g. to 0 or a huge height), hiding or disrupting the hosting page.
finding.failure_mode: Origin validation can be bypassed by a prefix-matching attacker origin.

finding.root_cause: The sender validation uses `indexOf` substring containment rather than an equality check against the expected origin.
finding.suggested_fix: Compare exactly, e.g. derive the Discourse origin once and use `if (e.origin !== discourseOrigin) { return; }`.
finding.title: postMessage origin check uses substring matching instead of exact origin comparison
finding.trigger: A message posted from any window whose origin string is a substring of discourseUrl, e.g. discourseUrl "http://discuss.example.com/" and an attacker-controlled frame/popup at "http://discuss.example.co".
finding.verifier_reason: Line 17 shows `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }`. indexOf checks substring containment, not exact match. An attacker origin like 'http://discuss.example.co' would pass if discourseUrl is 'http://discuss.example.com/'.

rejected_findings.reason: 0.800 is below 0.920: Line 17 shows `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }`. indexOf checks substring containment, not exact match. An attacker origin like 'http://discuss.example.co' would pass if discourseUrl is 'http://discuss.example.com/'.

finding.body: The iframe src becomes "http://discuss.example.comembed/best?...", the request fails to resolve and the embed renders empty.

finding.body: The `retrieved:<url>` key persists forever, so `retrieved_recently?` always returns true and that page's topic is never retrieved again for non-staff visitors.

validated_findings.body: The feed's HTML is stored verbatim in posts.cooked and later emitted through `<%= raw post.cooked %>` and the normal topic view, allowing stored XSS/arbitrary markup injection from the remote feed.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Untrusted markup is persisted as trusted cooked HTML and rendered to all viewers.
validated_findings.impact: The feed's HTML is stored verbatim in posts.cooked and later emitted through `<%= raw post.cooked %>` and the normal topic view, allowing stored XSS/arbitrary markup injection from the remote feed.
validated_findings.root_cause: The new raw_html branch bypasses the entire cooking/sanitizing pipeline for content that originates from untrusted remote sources.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Run raw_html content through the existing sanitizer (e.g. PrettyText/Sanitize with a whitelist) before returning it from `cook`, instead of returning `raw` unfiltered.
validated_findings.title: raw_html cook method stores unsanitized third-party HTML as cooked content
validated_findings.trigger: SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled with a feed whose item content contains `<script>` or event-handler attributes; Jobs::PollFeed calls TopicEmbed.import which creates the post with cook_method raw_html.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Line 133 shows `return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` bypassing cooking/sanitization. Posts imported via RSS with cook_method raw_html store unsanitized HTML. Evidence shows TopicEmbed.import uses cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html], enabling stored XSS from untrusted feeds.

validated_findings.body: NoMethodError on nil is raised inside the hourly job; because `sidekiq_options retry: false`, the whole polling run aborts and no items from that feed are ever imported.

validated_findings.root_cause: The importer assumes every feed item exposes a `content` attribute rather than handling the common RSS description-only case.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Fall back to `i.description` when `i.content` is blank and skip the item when both are missing, e.g. `content = i.content || i.description; next if content.blank?`.

validated_findings.verifier_reason: Line 35 shows `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` which calls .scrub on i.content. SimpleRSS returns nil for items without content element (RSS 2.0 description-only feeds), causing NoMethodError on nil.scrub.

validated_findings.root_cause: The rewrite to TopicEmbed.import_remote dropped the created_at option that the previous PostCreator invocation supplied.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Extend `TopicEmbed.import_remote`/`import` to accept and forward a `created_at` option and pass `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])` here, as the removed PostCreator call did.
validated_findings.title: Disqus import no longer preserves the original thread creation date
validated_findings.trigger: Running `thor disqus:import` on an export whose threads carry `created_at` values (previously passed to PostCreator).
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Patch shows line 148 changed from PostCreator.new with created_at parameter to TopicEmbed.import_remote without created_at. The original code passed `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])` which is now lost.

validated_findings.body: Those links/images are left untouched and resolve against the Discourse host, producing broken links and missing images in the imported post, contradicting the method comment "Convert any relative URLs to absolute".
validated_findings.failure_mode: Imported content renders broken links/images while the code comment implies full coverage.
validated_findings.impact: Those links/images are left untouched and resolve against the Discourse host, producing broken links and missing images in the imported post, contradicting the method comment "Convert any relative URLs to absolute".
validated_findings.root_cause: The rewrite logic tests only for a leading slash rather than resolving all relative references against the source URL.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Resolve every non-absolute href/src with `URI.join(url, value).to_s` (rescuing invalid URIs) instead of only handling values that start with '/'.
validated_findings.title: absolutize_urls only rewrites root-relative URLs despite claiming to handle relative URLs
validated_findings.trigger: An imported feed/article whose markup uses document-relative links such as `` or ``.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Line 64 shows `if href.present? && href.start_with?('/')` only handling root-relative URLs. Document-relative URLs like 'posts/x.html' are not handled despite comment claiming to 'Convert any relative URLs to absolute'.

validated_findings.body: A misleading dependency is loaded on every job load, implying the job sends email and adding needless coupling for maintainers.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Dead dependency misleads readers and slows load.
validated_findings.impact: A misleading dependency is loaded on every job load, implying the job sends email and adding needless coupling for maintainers.
validated_findings.root_cause: Copy-pasted require from another job file that was not removed.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Delete the `require_dependency 'email/sender'` line and keep only `require_dependency 'topic_retriever'`.
validated_findings.title: Unused require of 'email/sender' in the RetrieveTopic job
validated_findings.trigger: Reading or loading app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb; nothing in the file references Email::Sender.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: This is a stylistic/code quality issue about unused require. The finding is categorized as 'style' and has low severity. Per instructions, stylistic findings should be dropped.

validated_findings.body: Unused public method (and the `digest/sha1` require it motivates) suggests a conditional-GET caching feature that does not exist, misleading future maintainers.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Dead code implies behavior the job does not have.
validated_findings.impact: Unused public method (and the `digest/sha1` require it motivates) suggests a conditional-GET caching feature that does not exist, misleading future maintainers.
validated_findings.root_cause: Half-implemented caching helper committed without any call site.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Either remove `feed_key` or actually use it to store/compare the feed's Last-Modified value before parsing.
validated_findings.title: Dead `feed_key` method in PollFeed
validated_findings.trigger: Reviewing or maintaining Jobs::PollFeed; no caller anywhere references `feed_key`.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: This is a stylistic/code quality issue about dead code (unused method). The finding is categorized as 'style' and has low severity. Per instructions, stylistic findings should be dropped.

validated_findings.body: Regressions in feed parsing — such as the nil `i.content` crash for description-only RSS — ship undetected because no test loads a feed fixture.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Untested import path allows runtime failures to reach production.
validated_findings.impact: Regressions in feed parsing — such as the nil `i.content` crash for description-only RSS — ship undetected because no test loads a feed fixture.
validated_findings.root_cause: Tests were written only for the guard clauses in `execute`, leaving the job's real work uncovered.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Add an example that stubs `open` with an RSS/Atom fixture and asserts TopicEmbed.import is called with the expected url/title/content, including a description-only item.
validated_findings.title: PollFeed spec never exercises poll_feed's parsing/import logic
validated_findings.trigger: The suite only asserts the site-setting guards and the delegation; `poll_feed` (SimpleRSS parsing, `i.link`/`i.id` fallback, `i.content` handling, TopicEmbed.import call) is stubbed out in every example.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: This is a test coverage gap finding, not a defect in the production code. The test exists and tests delegation; claiming it should test more is a quality suggestion, not a bug introduced by the patch.

validated_findings.body: The example never verifies the missing-parameter behavior it names (and the name claims 404 while the code path yields 403), so removing `params.require(:embed_url)` would not fail the suite.
validated_findings.evidence:
it "is 404 without an embed_url" do
    get :best
    response.should_not be_success
validated_findings.failure_mode: False-positive coverage of the required-parameter check.
validated_findings.impact: The example never verifies the missing-parameter behavior it names (and the name claims 404 while the code path yields 403), so removing `params.require(:embed_url)` would not fail the suite.
validated_findings.root_cause: The test asserts only a generic non-success response without isolating the parameter-validation path.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Stub `SiteSetting.embeddable_host` and the referer so the filter passes, then assert `ActionController::ParameterMissing` is raised (and rename the example to match the real status).
validated_findings.title: Embed controller spec's missing-embed_url example passes for the wrong reason
validated_findings.trigger: `SiteSetting.embeddable_host` defaults to '' in the test environment, so `ensure_embeddable` raises InvalidAccess (403) before `params.require(:embed_url)` is ever reached.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: This is a test quality issue about test naming and assertion specificity. The test does verify non-success response. This is a test improvement suggestion, not a production code defect.

validated_findings.body: An orphan string is pushed to translators for every locale, wasting translation effort and implying a permalink UI that does not exist.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Translation catalog contains a string with no code reference.
validated_findings.impact: An orphan string is pushed to translators for every locale, wasting translation effort and implying a permalink UI that does not exist.
validated_findings.root_cause: A locale key was added ahead of (or after removal of) the feature that would consume it.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Remove the `permalink` key, or use it in app/views/embed/best.html.erb where a per-post permalink is intended.
validated_findings.title: Unused embed.permalink translation key added
validated_findings.trigger: No view, controller, or model added in this patch references `I18n.t('embed.permalink')`.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: This is a documentation/localization issue about potentially unused translation key. Categorized as 'doc_defect' with low severity. Without proof the key is truly unused (it may be used in views not shown), this is speculative.

validated_findings.body: Every cache miss downloads, parses and re-imports the whole configured feed synchronously, multiplying network and DB work (and duplicating the hourly scheduled run) for a single missing topic.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Redundant, unbounded feed processing under concurrent first-time embeds.
validated_findings.impact: Every cache miss downloads, parses and re-imports the whole configured feed synchronously, multiplying network and DB work (and duplicating the hourly scheduled run) for a single missing topic.
validated_findings.root_cause: A scheduled bulk job is invoked synchronously as a lookup mechanism for a single URL.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Rely on the scheduled PollFeed run (or guard this inline call with its own global throttle) instead of re-executing the full feed import per missing embed URL.
validated_findings.title: Embed cache miss runs the entire feed poll inline inside the retrieval job
validated_findings.trigger: feed_polling_enabled is on and several distinct embedded pages are visited for the first time within a short window, each enqueuing RetrieveTopic.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: This is a performance concern about design choice, not a bug. The code intentionally calls PollFeed inline as a fallback mechanism. This is a design decision with tradeoffs, not a defect.
